name: Exp_GTakeProfit_Tm
summary: Exp_GTakeProfit_Tm is an Expert Advisor utility that manages open positions by applying a group take-profit mechanism with time-based filtering. It monitors a portfolio of trades and closes all managed positions when the cumulative profit of the group reaches a specified target threshold, with optional time window restrictions for activation.
summary_zh: Exp_GTakeProfit_Tm是一个EA工具，通过时间过滤和组合止盈机制来管理持仓。它监控一组交易的累计利润，当组合总利润达到设定目标时关闭所有被管理的仓位，并支持可选的时间窗口限制来控制激活时段。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个仓位管理工具而非独立交易策略，其核心概念是组合止盈（Group Take Profit），即当一组关联仓位的累计浮盈达到用户设定的目标值时，统一平仓所有被管理的仓位。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不自行开仓，而是依赖外部已存在的仓位。出场条件为：组合总利润达到TakeProfit参数设定的值，或超出用户指定的时间窗口范围。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及建仓逻辑，但通过MagicNumber和符号过滤来选择要管理的特定仓位组。资金管理方面，组合止盈目标可以按金额设定，确保整体组合盈利达标后锁定利润。时间过滤功能允许用户限制EA仅在特定时段内执行组合止盈逻辑，避免非活跃时段的不必要操作。该EA还可能支持排除某些仓位或按特定条件筛选被管理仓位的功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a position management utility rather than an independent trading strategy. Its core concept is Group Take Profit, which closes all managed positions simultaneously when the cumulative floating profit of a designated group reaches a user-defined target. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open positions on its own but rather manages externally opened positions. Exit conditions trigger when the group's total profit hits the TakeProfit parameter threshold, or when operations fall outside the user-specified time window. Position management involves filtering positions by MagicNumber and symbol to select which positions belong to the managed group. Money management is handled through a fixed-amount group take-profit target, ensuring that overall portfolio gains are locked in once the cumulative threshold is met. The time filtering feature allows users to restrict the EA's active operation to specific trading sessions, preventing unnecessary actions during inactive periods. The EA may also support exclusion of certain positions or conditional filtering for more granular control over the managed position group.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 组合止盈目标金额（货币单位）
parameters.description_en: Group take profit target amount (in currency)

parameters.name: Magic
parameters.description: 魔幻号过滤，0表示管理所有手动仓位
parameters.description_en: Magic number filter, 0 means manage all manual positions

parameters.name: TimeStart
parameters.description: EA激活时间窗口起始时间

parameters.name: TimeEnd
parameters.description: EA激活时间窗口结束时间

parameters.name: OnlyProfit
parameters.description: 是否仅在组合盈利时执行平仓
parameters.description_en: Whether to close positions only when group is profitable

parameters.name: OnlyCurrentSymbol
parameters.description: 是否仅管理当前交易品种的仓位
parameters.description_en: Whether to manage positions of current symbol only

pros: 组合止盈机制有效锁定整体组合利润，防止单笔盈利被其他亏损仓位侵蚀
时间窗口过滤功能可避免在低流动性或高波动时段误触发平仓
通过魔幻号和品种筛选灵活管理不同策略的仓位组合，适配多策略并行场景
pros_en: Group take-profit mechanism effectively locks in overall portfolio gains, preventing individual profitable positions from being eroded by other losing positions
Time window filtering avoids unintended closures during low-liquidity or high-volatility periods
Magic number and symbol filtering provides flexible management of position groups from different strategies, suitable for multi-strategy parallel execution
cons: 作为工具类EA不包含独立交易信号，完全依赖外部仓位输入，单独使用无意义
组合止盈不设组合止损，若整体组合持续亏损则无保护机制可能造成重大损失
时间窗口限制可能导致盈利未达标但在窗口外无法触发平仓，错过最佳出场时机
cons_en: As a utility EA it contains no independent trading signals and relies entirely on external positions, making it meaningless when used alone
Group take-profit without a group stop-loss means there is no protection if the overall portfolio continues to lose, potentially causing significant losses
Time window restrictions may prevent closure when the window ends before the profit target is reached, potentially missing optimal exit opportunities
improvements: 增加组合止损功能，当组合总亏损达到设定阈值时自动平仓，提供下行保护
增加组合盈利的实时显示面板和通知功能，便于监控组合状态
improvements_en: Add a group stop-loss feature that automatically closes all positions when the cumulative loss reaches a defined threshold, providing downside protection
Add a real-time dashboard and notification system for group profit monitoring, making it easier to track the managed portfolio status

risk_points: 缺乏组合止损机制，组合亏损时无自动保护
时间窗口限制可能导致盈利窗口外无法执行平仓操作
risk_points_en: Lack of group stop-loss mechanism means no automatic protection when the portfolio is in loss
Time window restrictions may prevent closure operations outside the designated hours, even when favorable

summary_en: Exp_GTakeProfit_Tm is an Expert Advisor utility that manages open positions by applying a group take-profit mechanism with time-based filtering. It monitors a portfolio of trades and closes all managed positions when the cumulative profit of the group reaches a specified target threshold, with optional time window restrictions for activation.
